name: rakun-manual
description: Monorepo for Rakun, a TypeScript toolkit for content, routing, manager UI, and web integrations.

scripts.clean: rm -rf core/dist trpc/dist express/dist next/dist s3/dist react/dist manager-react/dist
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build
scripts.build:esm: bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build:esm && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build:esm
scripts.build:cjs: bun run --filter @rakun-kit/core build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/trpc build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/express build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/react build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/manager-react build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/next build:cjs && bun run --filter @rakun-kit/s3 build:cjs
